EtaEvidenceHeads.filter: explicit selected ViagemId list; primary key lookup; selection is not protection certification

EtaEvidenceJournal.filter: same explicit ViagemId list; (ViagemId,Sequence) unique index

EtaEvidenceOwners.filter: scope/token referenced by heads plus overlapping intervals for those scopes only

EtaProducerEpochs.filter: EpochIds referenced by selected heads/owners only

OutboxViagens.filter: explicit quality EventIds from selected head sequences; PK lookup
OutboxViagens.retention: pending OR processed receipt required by foundation verifier

guards: unknown or expired ACK receipt blocks certification
blockers: durable materialization receipt policy before outbox retention expires
